prova:
cases t with
  | zero =>
    have h : DivisorSumSet 0 = Set.univ := erdos_859.variants.trivial_case
    rw [h]
    exact Set.univ_hasPosDensity
  | succ t' =>
    let t := t' + 1
    have ht : 0 < t := by omega
    have h1 : { n | t ∣ n } ⊆ DivisorSumSet t := by
      intro n hn
      use {t}
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        simp [Nat.divisors] at hx ⊢
        exact hn
      · simp [Finset.sum_singleton]
    have h2 : ({ n | t ∣ n }).HasPosDensity := Nat.multiples_hasPosDensity t ht
    exact HasPosDensity.mono h1 h2
